60.why: Blank loading state (UX), not a wrong number: TS42 read Days used as empty while saved trips were loading. Now the tiles say Counting your saved trips…

_notes.text: Classified as a blank loading state (UX), not a wrong number. TS42 (leap-day stay leaves the window on day 181) failed once on PR #60 at commit 1abce4c (42/43, [execution](https://www.testsprite.com/dashboard-v3/o/1b474b7a-30a8-51f3-9b61-fd8a3c733650/projects/bd039118-0c25-4707-b018-b25619a37fce/execution/1f423c16-9271-4530-bbd6-11c6ec403bef)): the agent read the Days used cell as empty. A CLI rerun of TS42 alone against production passed (run 3f1d1a94-9544-4e94-9688-5ace96c0d741). Playwright never saw a wrong number, but with the CPU slowed 20x the status area was an empty skeleton for about 3 s, and the server HTML said only "Loading…" ([timeline](docs/evidence/testsprite/ts42-pr60/production-throttled-timeline.txt)). Fixed on #60: until the trips load, the Days used and Days left tiles say "Counting your saved trips…" ([red](docs/evidence/testsprite/ts42-pr60/vitest-red.txt), [green](docs/evidence/testsprite/ts42-pr60/vitest-green.txt)). The next full run, on 9a0c897 with the fix, was "All 43 tests passed" ([execution](https://www.testsprite.com/dashboard-v3/o/1b474b7a-30a8-51f3-9b61-fd8a3c733650/projects/bd039118-0c25-4707-b018-b25619a37fce/execution/eba1bf9c-2c9c-4a6a-8711-79b4955b870a)), and #60 merged as 9f781f6.
